info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Banking Accounts Beneficiaries-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Beneficiaries List API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of beneficiaries associated with their banking accounts. This endpoint is essential for financial institutions and developers creating applications that facilitate account management and beneficiary tracking. Users can easily access beneficiary details, streamlining processes like fund transfers and account audits. Typical consumers include bank customers and third-party financial service providers seeking to enhance their offerings with beneficiary management features.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of beneficiaries associated with a specific account, providing essential details about each beneficiary.

requestBody.description: A request body for retrieving a list of beneficiaries associated with an account. This request allows clients to specify any necessary filters or parameters to customize the returned list of beneficiaries.

200.description: Request completed successfully and beneficiaries data retrieved.
